card.fact_statement: The 14-day period for the second phase of the Chancellor election lasted until 20 May.
card.source_span: within a period of 14 days, i.e. until 20 May, a quarter of the members of the Bundestag could nominate a candidate for election as Federal Chancellor.

target_qa_variants.source_span: within a period of 14 days, i.e. until 20 May, a quarter of the members of the Bundestag could nominate a candidate for election as Federal Chancellor.

backtranslation_en.question: Until what date did the 14-day period for the second phase of the Chancellor election last before the formation of the Merz government?
